name: Cabyll-Ushtey

attributes.attribute: stole cattle and people from the land
drowned its victims in lakes or the sea

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cabyll-Ushtey is a Manx mythological creature. It is a variety of the water horse. The monster lived on the Isle of Man. It stole cattle, and sometimes people, from the land. Then it drowned them in lakes or in the sea.

okr.objective: Document the Manx water-horse monster Cabyll-Ushtey.
